reviewer_summary.question: Why must a chosen word be processed before choosing the following word, and what preparation can each layer keep for reuse?
reviewer_summary.takeaway: Choosing blue uses the preceding word’s finished result; blue must produce its own result, while each layer can reuse earlier keys and values because appending blue cannot change their inputs.

findings.problem: The first reading-number picture prematurely introduces supposedly previously computed fractions for The, sky and is. No fractions have been computed yet.

resolution.note: Ready-fraction reminders now require an explicit storyboard state flag on the three later value reminders. A regression requires an earlier fraction computation for that same position/pass/layer and forbids the early reminder.
